verdict.rationale: Unleash publishes a dedicated first-party guide on how to schedule feature releases, explicitly covering releasing a feature at a specific date and time, for example a product launch. The excerpts are thin and don't explain the mechanism, so the depth of support is unclear. Missing for 10: details of how scheduling works (e.g. date constraints vs. scheduled change requests), evidence that arbitrary flag changes beyond enabling a release can be scheduled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
